rows.ARS: White, near white or white blend Hybrid Tea.
rows.Origin:
Bred by Noack (Germany, 2001).
Introduced in Germany by W. Kordes' Söhne (Wholesale) in 2002 as 'Ambiente'.
rows.Bloom: Cream, buff center. Center champagne-coloured. Mild fragrance. Average diameter 4.75". Large, full (26-40 petals), in small clusters, high-centered to cupped bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Habit:
Short, upright. Large, glossy, dark green foliage.

Height: up to 35" (up to 90cm). Width: up to 35" (up to 90cm).
rows.Growing: USDA zone 6b through 9b (default). Can be used for beds and borders, container rose, cut flower or garden. Vigorous.
rows.Parentage: If you know the parentage of this rose, or other details, please contact us.
